tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt turns 2-3: copied 8 source files, rewrote namespaces, and produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md plus .bootstrap-meta.json.
session-log.txt turns 35-43: exposed WMC0035, enforced a clean build, and eventually reported zero residue, zero warnings, and a surviving startup.
session-log.txt turn 3 fetched only the navigation and project-file anchors needed for the shell conversion.

tools_problematic.problem: Its data-bound example depended on InvokedItemContainer.DataContext but did not prohibit a nested NavigationViewItem in MenuItemTemplate. The generated UI highlighted later items while the handler silently skipped Frame.Navigate.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt lines 447-520 and final MainPage.xaml/.cs; migration-score.json marks Installed Location and Dependencies fail because Identity content remained visible.

tools_problematic.problem: A validator launch ran while dotnet run was already holding the packaged app, producing an empty-signature startup-crash result.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turns 38-43: package-run5 remained running while validation reported crashed with blank code/type/message; after that run was stopped, Test-AppLaunch and validation passed.

tool_limitations.limitation: The final PASS checked source residue, build health, and process survival but did not reject the nested NavigationView container structure that caused dead scenario switching.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static XAML gate for NavigationView with MenuItemsSource whose MenuItemTemplate contains NavigationViewItem.

doc_errors.wrong: The data-bound recipe implied that InvokedItemContainer.DataContext would be the scenario item without showing the required content-only MenuItemTemplate.
doc_errors.correct: NavigationView must create the sole item container; a data-bound MenuItemTemplate should render content such as TextBlock, after which the generated container DataContext is the scenario item.

special_apis.special_handling: When the project namespace is also Package, alias the WinRT type (for example AppPackage) because Package.Current otherwise binds to the namespace and produces CS0234.
Use a content-only item template, explicitly navigate the first item on Loaded, and navigate later items from the generated container's bound data item.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: Current does not exist in namespace Package in all three scenario files
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold namespace Package shadowed Windows.ApplicationModel.Package.
errors_encountered.fix: Alias Windows.ApplicationModel.Package as AppPackage and use AppPackage.Current.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The hand-authored data template referenced a model name the XAML compiler could not resolve in the migrated project.
errors_encountered.fix: Rename the model consistently to MainPageScenario in XAML and C#.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0503: Compiled Bindings cannot be processed in Property Element form
errors_encountered.root_cause: MenuItemsSource was expressed as a property element containing x:Bind rather than as an attribute.
MenuItemsSource text was accidentally placed inside NavigationView content instead of on the start tag.
errors_encountered.fix: Move MenuItemsSource onto the NavigationView start tag.

errors_encountered.error: Validator reported startup crash with blank exception fields
errors_encountered.root_cause: The same packaged app was already running under a concurrent dotnet run invocation.
errors_encountered.fix: Stop the existing run and execute Test-AppLaunch/validation sequentially.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Four build/run attempts cycled through model resolution and malformed MenuItemsSource XAML before compiling.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The navigation anchor lacked a complete compile-safe XAML example and did not forbid a nested NavigationViewItem template.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent repaired each compiler error, but retained the nested-container runtime defect.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Provide a complete content-only data-template recipe and statically reject nested NavigationViewItem containers.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validation reported a startup crash without a code, type, message, or stack while another launch was still running.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: one false crash, one unrelated code edit, then a sequential retest
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Concurrent launch commands contended for the same packaged identity.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The long-running dotnet run process was stopped before Test-AppLaunch and validation were rerun.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the skill's sequential build-launch-validate loop and do not launch the same packaged app concurrently.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent claimed all three scenarios were preserved although only startup survival had been checked.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: It skipped the navigation anchor's explicit second-item switching check.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in the migration trial; scoring found two dead scenarios.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A mechanical nested-container validator gate plus the existing second-item switching requirement.

missing_tooling.need: Static detection of nested NavigationViewItem inside a data-bound MenuItemTemplate
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Prevented a validator PASS for a shell where selection changed but Frame content did not.
